title: Elixir of Dragonborn Prowess: Frost

sources.title: Ice Storm
markers: | description = Impel a storm of hail and ice to crash from the sky, covering the ground and striking all objects and creatures within range, dealing {{DamageType|Bludgeoning}} and {{DamageType|Cold}} damage. It also creates an {{Area|Ice}} surface that lasts 2 turns.

summary: Until Long Rest, gain Cold resistance, advantage on Intimidation and Persuasion checks, and one cast of Ice Storm.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Consume one bottle. Until Long Rest, gain Cold resistance, advantage on Intimidation and Persuasion checks, and one cast of Ice Storm.
fields.Acquisition: Trade silver or white dragonborn blood to Araj Oblodra in Moonrise Towers or the Lower City.
fields.Stacking: Araj’s elixirs stack with ordinary elixirs and other Araj elixirs.
fields.Ice Storm: Action. Within 60 ft, deal 2d8 Bludgeoning plus 4d6 Cold in a 20 ft radius, Dexterity save for half. Leaves Ice for 2 turns.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
